headline.zh: 为消费贷款构建AI代理工作流
headline.en: Build AI Agent Workflow for Consumer Lending

scenario.zh: 某地区银行希望在不更换核心系统的前提下,用AI代理自动化贷款审批流程
scenario.en: Regional bank wants to automate loan approval with AI agents without replacing core systems

instruction.zh: Kastle在现有系统之上运行,选择首个连接的数据源
instruction.en: Kastle runs on top of existing systems; select first data source to connect

output.zh: 工作流配置更新为读取账户余额和交易历史,代理可访问申请人财务快照
output.en: Workflow config updated to read account balances and transaction history; agent accesses applicant financial snapshot

output.zh: 工作流配置更新为拉取信用报告,代理可获取FICO评分和负债数据
output.en: Workflow config updated to pull credit reports; agent retrieves FICO scores and debt data

instruction.zh: 设定代理何时介入贷款流程
instruction.en: Set when the agent enters the lending process

output.zh: 触发器配置为监听申请表提交事件,代理立即启动文档收集和初审任务
output.en: Trigger configured to listen for application submit event; agent immediately starts doc collection and initial review tasks

output.zh: 触发器配置为等待所有材料上传,代理随后执行批量验证和风险评估
output.en: Trigger configured to wait for all materials uploaded; agent then performs batch validation and risk assessment

instruction.zh: 检查代理如何根据风险评分路由申请
instruction.en: Review how agent routes applications by risk score

output.zh: 路由规则显示高信用评分且低债务收入比的申请直接进入批准队列
output.en: Routing rule shows high credit score and low debt-to-income applications go directly to approval queue

output.zh: 路由规则显示其他申请标记风险点并分配给贷款专员,附带审核建议
output.en: Routing rule shows other applications flagged with risk points and assigned to loan officer with review suggestions

instruction.zh: 确认代理工作流如何改善运营效率
instruction.en: Confirm how agent workflow improves operational efficiency

output.zh: 工作流摘要显示低风险案件审批时间明显缩短,处理容量大幅提升
output.en: Workflow summary shows low-risk case approval time significantly reduced, processing capacity greatly increased

output.zh: 工作流摘要显示简单核验任务已自动化,贷款专员可专注边界案例
output.en: Workflow summary shows simple verification tasks automated, loan officers can focus on edge cases

takeaway.zh: Kastle让银行在遗留系统之上叠加AI代理,渐进式自动化贷款流程而无需替换核心架构
takeaway.en: Kastle layers AI agents on legacy systems, enabling incremental lending automation without core infrastructure replacement

initial.zh: 自动收集客户收入证明、信用报告,触发风险评分,符合条件的申请直接进入批准队列
initial.en: Auto-collect income docs, credit reports, trigger risk scoring, route qualified apps to approval queue
